authorization.actor: derived from authenticated server session, never supplied role in request
authorization.workspace: membership and object scope checked server-side on every path
authorization.local: loopback and scoped source principal, no hosted claim

pagination.totals: exact or explicitly estimated, never invented

control_limits_proposed.upload_expanded_limit: must be configured and tested before enabling archive types

idempotency.request_hash: stored compared value, NOT a component of unique_key
idempotency.retention: bind retention and expiry to action recovery window before implementation

job.cancel_race: succeeded may win if commit already happened before cancellation fence; API/UI must show the actual outcome, never pretend undo
job.lease: claim owner + epoch + expiry + fenced commit
job.retry: bounded attempt under policy; logical terminal retry creates related operation, no paid external retry without permission
job.progress: optional measured work counters; null means unknown
job.ack: 202 only after durable input+job commit; not completion

primary_capacity_target.behavior_source: unvalidated initial profile; replace fanout with observed waterfall before main; keep reference results
primary_capacity_target.engaged_definition: Unique authenticated principal with a meaningful business action scheduled in the rolling window, or a legitimately admitted job waiting within its declared deadline and age bound. Lock the cohort and cadence before the run.
primary_capacity_target.denominator_rule: Failures, timeouts and dropped work remain in the offered cohort and eligible scheduled-action denominator. Never define the population by successful completers; polling/health/auth-refresh alone is not meaningful completion.

permission_policy: See Phoi-hop-va-nghiem-thu.md role matrix; per-object membership/grants and server authority remain mandatory.

session_policy.actor: server session, never arbitrary client role
session_policy.tokens: no long-lived secret in browser localStorage
session_policy.multi_tab: invalidate state on logout/account/workspace change; context fence after awaits

response_boundary: Validate version/type/shape/scope at API and browser; unknown or invalid schema fails safely, no fallback to demo.
inventory_boundary: P01-P38 retained foundation; add auth start/callback, onboarding/provisioning or other core-journey routes to the actual OpenAPI when needed. Conditional alternative never removes the underlying core journey.
